name: Maya Gingham Tiered Dress
description: A midi dress in small black and white checks, with a collar, a V-neck and full sleeves gathered into elastic cuffs. The skirt falls in gathered tiers to mid-calf. Loose, modest and easy to wear every day.

name: Agni Ombre Tiered Maxi Dress
description: A maxi dress that shades from orange into bright red. It has a round neck with a tie, a ruffled yoke, full sleeves with frill cuffs and a wide tiered skirt that reaches the ankle. A bold choice for festive days and parties.

name: Mishti Check Kurti Dress
description: A knee-length A-line kurti dress in soft pink and white checks, with a notched V-neck and three-quarter sleeves. The cuffs are finished with pink scalloped embroidery. Light cotton for the office or everyday wear.

name: Dalim Ruffle-Sleeve Dress
description: A knee-length dress in maroon crepe with a high neck, a pintucked front decorated with small bows, and short ruffled sleeves. Ties at both sides pull in the waist. Suited to dinners and small parties.

name: Bokul Floral Collared Maxi Dress
description: A maxi dress in white cotton scattered with small pink and yellow flowers. It has a shirt collar, a V-neck, short sleeves and a fitted waist that opens into a very full skirt reaching the ankle. Cool and light for daytime events.

name: Akash Striped Ruffle Shirt Dress
description: A midi shirt dress in blue and white stripes, with a band collar, buttons down the front edged with ruffles, and full sleeves with buttoned cuffs. It falls straight to mid-calf. Smart enough for the office.

name: Jui Swiss-Dot Smock Top
description: A loose smock top in soft yellow cotton with small woven dots. It has a round neck, a gathered tier that flares to the hip and full balloon sleeves with frill cuffs. Relaxed and modest, and easy to wear with trousers.

name: Nilima Bow-Print Flutter Top
description: A white cotton top printed with small blue bows and ribbons. It has a round neck, pintucks down the front and short ruffled flutter sleeves, and flares gently to the hip. Light and cool for warm days.

name: Golap Cross-Stitch Tunic
description: A flared tunic in ivory cotton with pintucks at the front and wide full sleeves. Pink cross-stitch roses and a zigzag border in olive and navy run along the hem and the sleeves.

name: Shiuli Striped Scallop-Hem Top
description: A loose button-front top in bright turquoise with yellow stripes. It has a round neck, full balloon sleeves gathered into buttoned cuffs, and a scalloped hem that flares out to the hip. The cuffs are scalloped to match. A cheerful, easy piece for everyday wear.

name: Hridoy Gingham Heart-Pocket Top
description: A playful top in red and white checks with two heart-shaped pockets edged in ruffles. It has a V-neck with a tie, white trim down the front and full balloon sleeves with buttoned cuffs. Falls to the hip.

name: Raat Embroidered Tunic
description: A flared tunic in black crepe with white floral cutwork embroidery along the scalloped hem and the wide three-quarter sleeves. The V-neck placket is finished with white stitching. Dressy enough for dinners and festive evenings.

name: Shorshe Folk-Embroidered Tunic
description: A flared tunic in pale lemon cotton with folk-style cross-stitch embroidery in blue, yellow and red on the front, the hem and the sleeves. The neck closes with a tie and a small blue pom-pom, and the full sleeves are wide and loose.

name: Rani Straight Pants
description: Straight-leg pants in bright pink cotton with a comfortable elastic waist. They reach the ankle and pair easily with a kurti or a tunic, such as the Golap Cross-Stitch Tunic.

name: Bahar Embroidered Wide-Leg Trousers
description: High-waisted wide-leg trousers in maroon with front pleats. A garden of embroidered flowers and butterflies in white, blue, pink and mustard climbs up from each hem. They reach the ankle.

name: Lali Lace Tiered Skirt
description: A long skirt in bright red floral lace, gathered into tiers that open into a full hem at the ankle. It has an elastic waist and is fully lined. Pairs with a plain top for parties and festive days.

name: Kajol Pleated Wide-Leg Trousers
description: High-waisted wide-leg trousers in black crepe with front pleats. They fall straight and loose to the ankle. A plain base that goes with every top in the store.

name: Moti Ivory Palazzo Trousers
description: High-waisted palazzo trousers in ivory crepe with front pleats and side pockets. The legs are wide and straight and reach the ankle. A light neutral that pairs with printed tops and kurtis.

name: Megh Pleated Maxi Skirt
description: A long black skirt with a flat high waistband and deep pleats that open into a very full hem at the ankle. It moves well when walking and dresses up or down with any top.

name: Bindu Polka Dot Palazzo
description: Very wide palazzo trousers in white georgette with small black polka dots. They are so full that they look like a long skirt when you stand, and they reach the ankle. Fully lined, with a pleated waist.

name: Gulabi Embroidered Kurti and Palazzo Set
description: A two-piece set: a pink georgette kurti covered in tonal embroidery, with a lace-trimmed neck, hem and three-quarter sleeves, and lemon yellow palazzo trousers with a lace stripe down each side. Made for Eid and family events.

name: Rupa Top and Flared Pants Set
description: A two-piece set in rust crepe: a short top with pintucks at the front and full sleeves gathered at the cuff, and matching flared palazzo pants with an elastic waist and tasselled drawstring. Wear them together or separately.

name: Shapla Three-Piece Set
description: A three-piece set: a cream kurti with tonal embroidery and pink piping at the neck, pink straight pants with an elastic waist, and a sheer pink net scarf (orna). The kurti has three-quarter sleeves and falls to the thigh.

name: Komola Polka Dot Frill Set
description: A two-piece set in orange with white polka dots. The top has a collar edged in white trim, a gathered waist, a frilled hem and full balloon sleeves; the matching pants end in frilled hems. Bright and cheerful for outings.

name: Jharna Embroidered Kurti Set
description: A two-piece set in soft mint georgette: a kurti with a band collar, full sleeves and white paisley embroidery down the front, and matching pants with embroidered hems. Light, elegant and suited to Eid and dinners.

name: Neel Pinstripe Shirt and Pants Set
description: A two-piece set in navy with white pinstripes: a long shirt with a collar, a tie at the waist and full sleeves with buttoned cuffs, and matching pants with elastic hems. Smart for the office, relaxed enough for everyday.

name: Jaba Swiss-Dot Chiffon Dress
description: A flowing dress in hot pink chiffon woven with small white dots. It has a keyhole neck, sheer full sleeves gathered at the cuff, and a full skirt that falls below the knee. Lined under the skirt. Bright and pretty for parties and festive days.

name: Nisha Sleeveless Maxi Dress
description: A black maxi dress with wide shoulder straps and a fitted bodice that opens into a very full skirt. Bands of pink and white wavy ric-rac trim run around the bust and twice across the skirt. Wear it alone or layered over a fitted top.

name: Champa Embroidered Collar Dress
description: A lemon yellow dress in soft waffle-textured cotton with a button front and a tiered skirt that reaches mid-calf. The white collar and the short sleeves are embroidered with small orange and green flowers. Fresh and easy for warm days.

name: Doel Floral Yoke Dress
description: A loose midi dress in white cotton printed with small blue flowers and bows. The front yoke is embroidered in blue and pink and closes with a tie, and the full sleeves are gathered into balloon cuffs. Relaxed and modest for everyday wear.

name: Aparajita Puff-Sleeve Floral Dress
description: A knee-length dress in periwinkle blue with a white flower print. It has a square neck, short puff sleeves, a fitted waist and a ruffled hem. Light and feminine for lunches, outings and small parties.

name: Kamini Ditsy Floral Ruffle Dress
description: A dress in soft pink cotton covered with tiny flowers. Ruffled trim edges the yoke and the shoulders, the full sleeves end in elastic cuffs, and a gathered skirt falls below the knee. A sweet, modest everyday piece.

name: Surjo Flower-Patch Shirt Top
description: A loose shirt dress in white and grey pinstripes with a contrast brown collar and pocket. Large mustard flower patches are sewn down one side of the button front, each with a brown centre. Full sleeves and an easy A-line shape that falls to the knee.

name: Polash Embroidered Flower Dress
description: An A-line dress in ivory cotton scattered with small red embroidered flowers. It has a notched round neck and three-quarter sleeves, and flares gently to the knee. Simple and neat enough for the office or a day out.

name: Shishir Eyelet Tiered Dress
description: A white dress in fine embroidered eyelet cotton with a band collar, full sleeves gathered at the cuff and a tiered skirt that reaches mid-calf. Fully lined. A fresh, elegant choice for Eid mornings and daytime events.

name: Lilac Printed Panel Maxi Dress
description: A white maxi dress with a V-neck and a very full skirt that reaches the ankle. A printed panel of blue and orange swirls wraps the waist and repeats on the short sleeves. Striking for festive gatherings and dinners.

name: Pata Leaf-Cutwork Tunic
description: A flared tunic in teal crepe with a keyhole neck. Large monstera leaves in pink and green cutwork embroidery decorate the scalloped hem and the wide three-quarter sleeves. Pairs well with plain trousers such as the Kajol Pleated Wide-Leg Trousers.

name: Taara Night-Sky Palazzo
description: Navy palazzo trousers with an elastic waist and wide flared legs. Above each hem runs a swirling night-sky print in blue, gold and green with a glowing moon. A plain top lets the hems stand out.

name: Shondha Three-Piece Set
fabric: Textured georgette with a chiffon scarf
description: A three-piece set in lilac: a kurti in a soft textured fabric with three-quarter sleeves, matching straight pants with tasselled ties, and a light chiffon scarf (orna). Elegant for Eid, dinners and family events.

name: Sonali Embroidered Kurti Set
description: A two-piece set in rich mustard georgette: a long kurti with a V-neck covered in colourful thread and sequin embroidery, full sleeves with embroidered cuffs, and matching pants with embroidered hems. Made for Eid and festive days.

name: Bhor Asymmetric Kurti Set
description: A two-piece set in lavender: a kurti with tonal thread embroidery, a V-neck, wide full sleeves edged in lace and an asymmetric hem that dips to one side, with matching straight pants. Soft and graceful for festive gatherings.

name: Kashful Lace-Up Blouse and Pleated Skirt Set
fabric: Cotton blouse with a crepe skirt
description: A two-piece set: a cream blouse with a lace-up front, a band collar and brown floral embroidery on the full sleeves, and a high-waisted chocolate brown maxi skirt with deep pleats. Wear them together or separately.

name: Shobuj Embroidered Top and Palazzo Set
description: A two-piece set: a white top with green floral embroidery on the scalloped three-quarter sleeves, and sage green wide-leg palazzo trousers with a tie at the waist. Fresh and easy for everyday outings.

name: Kokil Mandarin Shirt and Flared Pants Set
description: A two-piece set in deep magenta crepe: a long shirt with a mandarin collar, fabric-covered buttons down the front and full sleeves, and matching flared pants with an elastic waist. Bold and polished for parties.

name: Phul Embroidered Shirt and Seersucker Pants Set
description: A two-piece set in soft lilac-pink seersucker: a collared shirt embroidered with red and orange flowers, with full sleeves, and matching wide-leg pants with a high waist. Light and cool for warm days.
